question: In this Canvas course, where do I submit my project update and see instructor feedback? Can I continue while my quiz essay is pending review?
answer:
**Submitting your project update:** After Finish, click **Canvas Next** to open this unit's practice and check-in quiz. Answer the three choice questions, then type your project update in the final written question. It's worth 0 points. Click **Submit Quiz**. If Next isn't available, go to Canvas Modules and open the Unit 6 quiz. Don't use the optional discussion for this update. For Unit 6, your update should cover what you decided, the evidence you used, and one uncertainty to test next. The course asks you to add your project evidence and reflection to the check-in in Canvas. ([Unit 6 check-in guidance](/teaching/ai-solutions/unit-06.html#section-3))

**Seeing instructor feedback:** Open **Canvas Grades**, select the quiz, and check the submission details. Instructor comments and any returned rubric or score appear there when available. Written feedback may still be pending, so don't be concerned if it isn't there yet. I can't see your submission or whether feedback has been returned.

**Continuing while the essay is pending:** Yes. A submitted quiz attempt meets the submission requirement for this edition, even while the written response awaits instructor review. Continue with Canvas Next or Modules. Submission records receipt only. It doesn't confirm correctness or mastery.

If your Canvas instructions say something different, follow those instructions.
